<!-- link2 "<U>Item&nbsp;3.01. Notice of Delisting or Failure to Satisfy a Continued Listing Rule or Standard; Transfer of Listing</U>." -->
<DIV align="left"><A NAME="000"></A></DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 12pt"><U><B>Item&nbsp;3.01. Notice of Delisting or Failure to Satisfy a Continued Listing Rule or Standard;
Transfer of Listing</B></U><B>.</B>
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt">(a)&nbsp;On May&nbsp;22, 2007, LOUD Technologies Inc. (the &#147;Company&#148;) received notice from The Nasdaq Stock
Market Inc. that the Company&#146;s securities were subject to potential delisting due to the fact that
it was not in compliance with Nasdaq Marketplace Rule&nbsp;4310(c)(14) as a result of the Company&#146;s
failure to file its report for the quarter ended March&nbsp;31, 2007 on Form 10-Q on a timely basis.
</DIV>

<DIV align="left" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 6pt">The Company filed a Notice of Late Filing on Form 12b-25 on May&nbsp;15, 2007. The Company anticipates
that it will file its report for the quarter ended March&nbsp;31, 2007 on Form 10-Q on May&nbsp;25, 2007. At
that time, the Company expects to be in compliance with the standards for continued listing on
Nasdaq.
</DIV>


<P align="center" style="font-size: 10pt"><!-- Folio -->&nbsp;<!-- /Folio -->
</DIV>
